mode: RETROSPECTIVE RESEARCH ONLY: current government snapshot, not verified historical vintages. Feature-view availability assumes next-day 00:00 Asia/Kolkata publication. sample_policy.embargo: Purge origins whose exact +1-calendar-day target crosses partition end; labels must be available before next partition begins

horizons.selection_reason: Lowest validation MAE among reliable candidates; CV variability and p90 overprediction break ties. ML/seasonal promotion requires beating every core baseline in >=2/3 CV folds and beating the best validation baseline on validation and mean CV MAE.
